meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建可渲染的动画合成项目,让画面与音轨按时序精准播出
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把创意做成能稳定渲染、按时间轴精确播放的视频项目
copy.tagline_en: Build renderable animated projects with clips playing in precise timing order
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn ideas into reliably rendered video or animation projects

howto.what: 帮你按 HyperFrames 契约写出一份可渲染的合成 HTML：DOM 用 data-* 声明时间、只注册一个暂停时间轴、媒体播放归框架管，并跑校验。
howto.when: 在写合成 HTML 之前读；涉及合成结构、data-* 时间属性、class="clip" 等时使用，也覆盖 Tailwind 项目和 STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md 计划格式。

howto.what_en: It builds one renderable HyperFrames composition HTML: DOM timing via data-* attributes, a single paused timeline registered at window.__timelines, framework-owned media playback, plus validation. Also covers Tailwind and plan formats.
howto.when_en: Read before writing composition HTML; use for composition structure, data-* timing attributes, class="clip", and more — also Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats.
